final_response.answer: For a CS major focused on cybersecurity, the Secure Computing major’s required electives include CS 3214 (Computer Systems), CS 4264 (Principles of Computer Security), CS 3314 (Programming Language Theory and Practice), and CS 3754 (Cloud Software Development) or CS 3714 (Mobile Software Development) as optional tracks. The Computational Modeling and Data Analytics major with the Cryptography and Cybersecurity option also adds MATH 4176 and MATH 4175 (both Cryptography) plus CS 2505 (Introduction to Computer Organization). These courses directly support a cybersecurity focus.
